item.subject: science
item.stem:
In Meera's school in Pune, the teacher begins the chapter 'The ever-evolving world of science' by asking why the monsoon arrives at different times each year. Meera and her friend Arjun note their questions, plan a small test with puddles drying in sunlight and shade, and look for patterns in their observations.

Their friend Kabir says science is only the list of correct facts printed in the textbook.

Which row correctly describes how science is being treated in this chapter?

options.A: Meera and Arjun: memorising facts; Kabir: memorising facts
options.B: Meera and Arjun: questioning and experimenting; Kabir: memorising facts
options.C: Meera and Arjun: questioning and experimenting; Kabir: questioning and experimenting
options.D: Meera and Arjun: memorising facts; Kabir: questioning and experimenting
